Generate contours for Mount [Popocatepetl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Popocat%C3%A9petl) using the technique of [Tanaka](http://wiki.gis.com/wiki/index.php/Tanaka_contours).

We will use the following packages:
```{r message=FALSE}
library(elevatr) # To get elevation data
library(MexBrewer) # Color palettes
library(metR) # For contouring 
library(showtext) # For importing fonts
library(terra) # To work with rasters
library(tidyverse) # Data carpentry and ggplot2
```

## Retrieve elevation data and process

Use {elevatr} to get elevation data:
```{r}

popo <- get_elev_raster(locations = data.frame(x = c(-98.575, -98.685), 
                                               y = c(18.935, 19.105)),
                        z = 10, 
                        prj = "EPSG:4326",
                        clip = "locations")
```

Convert to {terra} `SpatRaster` object and thereof to data frame:
```{r}
popo <- rast(popo)

popo <- as.data.frame(popo, 
                      xy = TRUE) %>%
  rename(elev = 3)
```

## Plot contours

Plot contours; use `Revolucion` palette from [{MetBrewer}](https://github.com/BlakeRMills/MetBrewer):
```{r}
cols <- mex.brewer("Revolucion", n = 11)

ggplot(data = popo,
       aes(x, y, z = elev)) +
  geom_contour_filled(breaks = seq(min(popo$elev), 
                                   max(popo$elev), 
                                   length.out = 11)) +
  #geom_contour_tanaka() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  coord_equal()
```

Repeat plot but now with Tanaka countours:
```{r}
ggplot(data = popo,
       aes(x, y, z = elev)) +
  geom_contour_filled(breaks = seq(min(popo$elev), 
                                   max(popo$elev), 
                                   length.out = 11)) +
  geom_contour_tanaka(sun.angle = 60, 
                      smooth = 10) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
 coord_equal() +
  theme_void() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.background = element_rect(color = NA,
                                       fill = cols[6]),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                  size = 100, 
                                  hjust = 0.5,
                                  vjust = -6),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "black",
                                     size = 80, 
                                  hjust = 0.5,
                                  vjust = -147),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 40,
                                    hjust = 0.9,
                                  vjust = 15))
  

ggsave("popo-tanaka-contours.png",
       width = 8,
       height = 12,
       units = "in")
```
